facts.statement: Friedrich von Huene named and described the species as Saltopus elginensis in 1910.
facts.quote: it was later named and described by Friedrich von Huene in 1910 as the type species Saltopus elginensis.

facts.statement: Saltopus is a genus of very small bipedal dinosauriforms.
facts.quote: Saltopus ("hopping foot") is a genus of very small bipedal dinosauriform

facts.statement: Saltopus had hollow bones similar to those of birds and other dinosaurs.
facts.quote: It had hollow bones like those of birds and other dinosaurs.

facts.statement: Saltopus may have weighed around 1 kg.
facts.quote: It may have weighed around 1 kg.

facts.statement: The holotype was excavated from the Lossiemouth Sandstone Formation, dating from the Carnian-Norian stages.
facts.quote: The holotype, NHMUK PV R 3915, was excavated from the Lossiemouth Sandstone Formation, which dates from the Carnian-Norian stage.

facts.statement: Saltopus has been variously classified as a saurischian dinosaur, an advanced theropod, or a relative of herrerasaurs, though its taxonomy remains disputed due to fragmentary remains.
facts.quote: Saltopus has been variously identified as a saurischian (lizard-hipped) dinosaur, a more advanced theropod, and a close relative of the herrerasaurs, but its taxonomy has been in dispute because only fragmentary remains have been recovered.

facts.statement: Rauhut and Hungerbühler concluded in 2000 that Saltopus is a primitive dinosauriform closely related to Lagosuchus, not a true dinosaur.
facts.quote: Rauhut and Hungerbühler in 2000 concluded it is a primitive dinosauriform, not a true dinosaur, closely related to Lagosuchus.

facts.statement: Rauhut and Hungerbühler suggested Saltopus is a primitive dinosauromorph, not a true dinosaur, but closely related to Lagosuchus.
facts.quote: En cambio Rauhut y Hungerbühler sugirieron que se trata de un primitivo dinosauriomorfo, no un verdadero dinosaurio, sino cercano a Lagosuchus.

facts.statement: Michael Benton concluded in 2011 that Saltopus is a dinosauriform more derived than Pseudolagosuchus but outside the clade containing Silesauridae and Dinosauria.
facts.quote: Michael Benton, continuando los estudios del difunto Alick Walker redescribiendo el fósil, concluyó en un estudio de 2011 que era un dinosauriforme más derivado que Pseudolagosuchus pero por fuera del clado menor que incluye a los Silesauridae y los Dinosauria.

facts.statement: A 2017 phylogenetic analysis by Baron, Norman, and Barrett found Saltopus near the base of the dinosaur lineage, suggesting it may be the closest relative of true dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Un análisis filogenético de los dinosaurios primitivos y otros dinosauromorfos fue publicado por Baron, Norman & Barrett en 2017, y en este se encuentra que Saltopus estaría cerca de la base del linaje de los dinosaurios, sugiriendo que puede ser el pariente más cercano de los dinosaurios verdaderos.

facts.statement: In 2011, it was established that the sacrum consists of only two vertebrae, the primitive ancestral condition, rather than four.
facts.quote: Contrariamente a la descripción científica original, en 2011 se estableció que el sacro (las vértebras de la cadera) se componía de solo dos vértebras, la condición primitiva ancestral, no de cuatro.

facts.statement: Saltopus lived from the Carnian to the Norian stages, between 237 and 205.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Norian (237 to 205.7 million years ago)
